About Us

One family, every part of student life

Sanatan Students' Society is a holistic and inclusive student-led organization rooted in the eternal philosophy of Sanatan Dharma. Established at the University of Calgary in September 2024, our mission is to support students in all aspects of life — spiritual, cultural, academic, mental, and professional — through timeless values such as compassion, discipline, self-reflection, and service.

What sets us apart is our all-encompassing approach. While many clubs focus on a single dimension, we integrate spirituality, culture, career development, and community service under one unified framework — offering volunteering, job, and networking opportunities that enhance every member's university experience.

Guided by our motto "Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam" — The World is One Family — we welcome students of all backgrounds and nationalities, united by shared values of service, reflection, and growth.

Spiritual Growth

Biweekly Kirtans and Sanatan philosophy seminars for reflection and inner peace.

Cultural Celebrations

Vibrant festivals — Diwali, Holi, Navratri, Janmashtami and more — celebrated on campus.

Career & Service

Volunteering, networking, and career sessions that build real-world skills.

Mental Wellbeing

Kirtan and meditation sessions supporting student mental health.

Chanakya Vidyarthi Bursary

Supporting Our Vidyarthis

Heartfelt thanks to all who applied for the Chanakya Vidyarthi Bursary. We are truly encouraged by the overwhelming interest and number of applications received. Recipients — Fall 2025:

Mandeep Kumar

Vidyarthi, Chanakya Vidyarthi Bursary

An undergraduate student at the University of Calgary who actively contributes to community volunteering initiatives centered on Sanatan Dharma and is a dedicated member of the Society.

Soujatya Mondal

Vidyarthi, Chanakya Vidyarthi Bursary

An undergraduate student at the University of Calgary who actively serves the community through initiatives inspired by Sanatan Dharma and is a committed member of the Society.

Harshita Chokkalingam

Vidyarthi, Chanakya Vidyarthi Bursary

An undergraduate student at the University of Calgary involved in community volunteering guided by Sanatan Dharma and an active contributor to the Society.

For those whose applications weren't approved this semester — don't be disheartened. The Chanakya Vidyarthi Bursary will reopen next semester. Follow us for updates!
